annotations.title: Compare caller-supplied auto insurance quotes apples-to-apples

description: Normalize 1 to 10 caller-supplied auto insurance quotes (monthly, 6-month, or annual, plus optional fees) to annualized and monthly-equivalent cost, rank from lowest to highest, calculate differences against an optional current declarations-page policy, flag coverage downgrades (lower liability limits, higher deductibles, or omitted UM/UIM), and attach verified carrier financial-strength context when recognized. Mathematical comparison of supplied inputs only; does not produce binding offers or endorse insurers.

current_policy.description: Optional current declarations-page policy details used as the apples-to-apples baseline for savings and coverage-downgrade checks.

bi_per_accident_usd.description: Bodily injury liability limit per accident in USD (e.g. 300000 for 100/300/100).

bi_per_person_usd.description: Bodily injury liability limit per person in USD (e.g. 100000 for 100/300/100).

carrier.description: Insurer or underwriting company name (optional; cross-referenced against RateZip's verified carrier quality registry when supplied).

fees_usd.description: Optional policy, billing, or installment fees in USD charged per term (defaults to 0 when omitted; omitted fees remain unknown if charged by the insurer).

label.description: Label for current policy (defaults to 'Current policy').

pd_limit_usd.description: Property damage liability limit in USD (e.g. 100000 for 100/300/100).

premium_usd.description: Quoted or current policy premium in USD for the specified term_months.

term_months.description: Policy billing/pricing period in months: 6 (semi-annual), 12 (annual), or 1 (monthly).

um_uim_included.description: Whether Uninsured/Underinsured Motorist (UM/UIM) coverage is included.

quotes.description: One to ten caller-supplied auto insurance quotes to normalize to annualized cost, rank, and audit for coverage differences.

bi_per_accident_usd.description: Bodily injury liability limit per accident in USD (e.g. 300000 for 100/300/100).

carrier.description: Insurer or underwriting company name (optional; cross-referenced against RateZip's verified carrier quality registry when supplied).

fees_usd.description: Optional policy, billing, or installment fees in USD charged per term (defaults to 0 when omitted; omitted fees remain unknown if charged by the insurer).

label.description: Short label for this quote (e.g. 'Quote A - CSAA').
